name: Grand Hyatt Indian Wells Resort & Villas
positioning: Family-friendly desert resort in Greater Palm Springs with a golf course, a water park, Agua Serena Spa and one- and two-bedroom villas with private backyards
best_for: Families who want a water park with waterslides and a lazy river
Groups and couples wanting a villa with a private patio, fireplace and barbecue
Travelers combining golf, tennis and spa time

facts.text: The resort is in Greater Palm Springs and has a golf course.
The resort's pools are set against a backdrop of mountains and palm trees.
The resort has walking and biking trails and tennis courts.
The resort's one- and two-bedroom villas have expansive living rooms and private furnished backyards.
The One Bedroom Villa has a living space with a fireplace, a dining area with a wet bar, a private patio with a barbecue, and views of the mountains and golf course.
Rooms have a spa-inspired marble bathroom with a separate shower and tub, and a private balcony.
Ground-floor 2 King Beds with Pool Access rooms have easy access to the pool and an outdoor patio.
Tía Carmen is an upscale restaurant by chef Angelo Sosa that pays homage to the Southwest's stories, land and farmers.
Private dining in the villas ranges from BBQ packages and personal chef experiences to charcuterie boards and wine selections.
The Living Desert Zoo and Gardens and the shops of El Paseo are nearby.
The resort was named in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2023 and 2025.

highlights.text: HyTides Plunge is a three-story water park attraction with dueling waterslides, a lazy river and a splash pad.
The Two Bedroom Villa with Premium Outdoor Terrace has a terrace with an elevated daybed, a hot tub and a fire pit.
The Presidential Villa opens to golf course or lagoon views and has a private patio with an outdoor spa and a barbecue.
Agua Serena Spa offers facials, massages and body treatments, a yoga studio and classes, wellness consultations and a 24-hour fitness studio.
Villa stays include complimentary spa access.

considerations.text: A daily resort fee is applied to each room.
Palm Springs International Airport is 12 miles away.
WhataHotel notes the location requires a car or transport to reach Palm Springs dining and nightlife.
